name: Gravity Gauntlet
design_intent:
MAYHEM MILE 19 (tier 3) — gravity well plus a lethal rotor. A central GRAVITY_SOURCE (moon, non-lethal bounce body, g 1000 inside radius 1500) bends every arc, while a single lethal spinning_hammer sweeps the RIGHT rim island -- the one island worth fighting over (it holds a powerup) is also the dangerous one. The well curves your approach to the hammer island and amplifies knockbacks toward the void. Read the pull AND the blade. Reuses shipped gravity_source (bumper core) + SpinningHammer -> head contact = kill(&ring_out); the moon never kills. kill_shape void_is_floor -> QA K1'.

DOCTRINE FIT (§2.0): (1) LETHAL -- only the hammer head kills by contact (kill(&ring_out)); the moon is a bumper, the void + bounds are the other shared killers. No new death path/scorer. (2) TELEGRAPHY -- the gravity_source draws its field-extent ring (radius 1500); the hammer is a single bold blade on a 4.0s period with a ~0.96s apex dwell + hazard-red swept arc. (3) FAIRNESS -- the well is symmetric about (2200,650); the ONE hammer over the Right island is the single asymmetry, and it is offset by fair access: spawns are on the three SAFE islands (Left/Top/Bottom), the hammer island is reached by flight only when you choose to contest its powerup, and the blade's apex dwell always returns a clear window. No spawn under the blade or inside the pull-decay death cone. (4) CREDIT -- a hammer/void death with no attacker = uncredited self-fall; a rival knocked into the blade / off the ring within 6.0s is credited. No environment scorer.

GEOMETRY (radial diamond, symmetric well about x2200): moon gravity_source at (2200,650), radius 1500, g 1000, lethal_core_r 0, visual moon, body_r 120, tier bumper. Four trampoline islands (h120): LEFT x350..1050 top y600, RIGHT x3350..4050 top y600 (the HAMMER island), TOP x1850..2550 top y100, BOTTOM x1850..2550 top y1250. HAMMER over Right island: pivot (3700,0), arm_len 590, arc_deg 150, period_s 4.0, phase 0.0, radius 70, head_len 160, head_w 104, dwell_frac 0.24 (at bottom-swing the head sits ~10px above the Right deck at y590; toward apex it lifts high and out). Bounds left -250, right 4650, top -750, bottom 2030 (>= 660px recovery sky under the BOTTOM island bottom y1370; clear sky above TOP and above the hammer apex). Bottom VOID x-250 y1500 w4900 h530, wall_px 120, reads as death via pit_void_rendering.

MOVEMENT-TOOL-PER-GAP (flight-required; trampoline apex 270 => ~395px drift; spring 480 => ~527px max drift; the well bends arcs):
- LEFT<->TOP / LEFT<->BOTTOM / TOP<->RIGHT / BOTTOM<->RIGHT (adjacent diamond hops, each ~650-710px diagonal with the well pulling back toward the moon): NORMAL BOOST REQUIRED; boost across the pull. Verb: FLY (+ read the curve).
- Any island -> RIGHT hammer island: a flight-required hop INTO a swept deck -- time the blade's apex-dwell as you arrive. Verb: FLY (+ TIME).
- TOP<->BOTTOM straight (past the moon, ~980px): the moon body blocks the straight line; arc a boosted route around it. Verb: FLY.
- Zero-boost off any island decays toward the moon/void (never reaches a neighbour): flight is REQUIRED to hold an orbit or cross; the well only bends the required boost line, the hammer only times the Right-island fight -- neither creates a bounce path.

SIGNATURE / DISTINCT: the only well + machine combo (moon_pit is well-only, hammer_arena hammer-only). One-sentence read: 'let the moon sling you toward the swinging blade island, grab its powerup, and smash rivals off the ring.'
